summary: Round-3 final review of the evidence and preparation at af2e612 (notes/sim10_perlmutter_baseline_20261115 only). PM-R2-01 is closed. evidence/runner-port.diff is a full origin-to-port diff, and every '+' hunk matches the committed runner.py: subprocess import, the vendor path/normalize_pci import, SLURM_PROCID, the sharing-only-for-bridge gate, granted-UUID and helper-mask checks, the Cray MPICH check, lustre media, the bindings/budget_peaks contexts, kernel precompile, the normalize_pci UUID/PCI gate at :125-128, n_bd_per_gpu, the progress receipts at :166-167 and :184-185, actual-open coverage, active_gpus placement, every-BD exercise, and the report fields. limitations.md:32-36 documents the diff. The bundle identity is preserved. evidence/prepared-bundle.json records commit 296d699 and 44 files, and its hashes are the same 44 hashes as the exact-commit host-checks06 receipt (git_head 296d699, empty working status, pytest exit 0; host-tests.log:25 shows 90 passed and 64 subtests passed). I spot-checked runner, campaign, run.sbatch, prepare, audit, support, status and the vendor files. The bundle also pins 7 external files, including the calibration manifest. bundle-verification.json records committed-bytes match, file mode 0444 / directory mode 0555, matching external pins, the plan SHA, and no submission. prepare.py:23-27 copies only files whose bytes equal git HEAD, and campaign.verify_bundle re-hashes files, externals and the plan at start and end. prepared-plan.json matches PLAN.md. The budget sums to 5400 s, the cases sum to 3360 s, and the bridge/1BD/4BD order rotates across the three repeats. Both bundle and plan are tied to 296d699 and manifest b8765377. The SUBMISSION.md command keeps the reviewed allocation (lcls_g/premium, gpu, 1 node, 4 GPUs, exclusive, 01:30:00; the script fixes 128 CPUs and mem=0). It adds only --dependency=afterany:61372107 and --chdir/--output/--error under the attempt directory, and it passes the exact path that run.sbatch:15 asserts. There are two low, non-blocking gaps. First, the recorded queue shows a second running job, 61372507 (pr299-pilot), whose count2 usage is not addressed (PM-R3-01). Second, status.json still lists PM-R2-01 as unresolved (PM-R3-02). The bundle and command are ready to go to the user for submission approval, subject to the pre-submit squeue/Iris refresh that SUBMISSION.md already requires. No GPU, Slurm, memory-fit, reference-cost or runtime result exists, and none is claimed.
